findings.text: Object pool exposes creation with count size flags context and callbacks, explicit teardown, single object release with reference drop, and bulk drain. Creation validates limits and prepares per processor storage; teardown releases storage and invokes user cleanup; single release frees only on last reference; bulk drain empties retained objects before releasing.

Object identifier helpers expose lookup from raw bytes, parsing from tagged encoding into enumerated value, and rendering to dotted decimal text. Lookup returns sentinel when absent; parsing validates header before lookup; rendering writes readable numbers and reports encoding or space failures.

One shot helpers expose start and finish pairs for non sleepable and sleepable contexts. Start acquires protection and reports whether caller should run payload; finish marks completion, releases protection, and arranges deferred deactivation of associated optimization.

Bit packing exposes single field store and load over a byte buffer with bit range and quirk controls, a dispatching wrapper selecting direction by operation, and bulk field array transfers for narrow and wide descriptor variants plus size specific structure conversions.

Creation rejects nonpositive or over maximum counts and sizes, rounds object size up to machine word granularity, derives slot capacity as power of two of requested count, clears control block, records processor count size capacity filtered flags context and cleanup callback, allocates pointer array for all processor identifiers, then builds per processor slots and cleans up on failure while establishing reference count on success.

Per processor construction walks all processor identifiers, skips never possible ones, shares requested objects evenly with remainder assigned to early visited slots, sizes each slot as descriptor plus embedded objects, prefers virtual allocation except under atomic context and falls back to node local allocation, clears storage, records slot pointer, then initializes slot contents and propagates failures.

Teardown tolerates absent slot array, releases each per processor slot with virtual aware free then releases pointer array, and invokes user cleanup only when present with stored context. Single release validates pointers and frees whole pool only when reference reaches zero, otherwise signals retry. Bulk drain repeatedly extracts retained objects while counting extra references then conditionally frees.

Lookup derives an eight bit hash from length and weighted byte sum with folded shifts, then binary searches a table ordered by hash then length then reverse byte order, comparing tails first because variation concentrates there, and returns matching enumeration or end sentinel when no entry matches.

Parsing requires at least three bytes with expected tag and length byte matching remaining payload, then resolves payload through lookup and reports success when header checks pass, leaving absence signalled through returned enumeration rather than error.

Rendering requires nonempty input, splits first byte into two decimal components by division and remainder with base forty, decodes subsequent base one twenty eight continuations with high bit chaining, appends each component as decimal with separator, fails when output space is exhausted or input ends mid sequence, and writes a bad marker on malformed input.

Single field transfer treats start bit as inclusive high end and end bit as inclusive low end, rejects inverted ranges or start beyond buffer, rejects widths above sixty four bits, computes width from inclusive difference, and otherwise delegates to internal byte wise transfer.

Internal transfer views buffer as logical bytes indexed from high to low significance, processes each affected byte box by intersecting requested range, projects box bits onto value bits with masks, remaps logical box to physical offset according to word order and byte order quirks, optionally reverses bit order within byte, then merges bits while preserving unrelated bits for store or accumulating into cleared result for load.

Address remap groups bytes in fours, selects group origin from start or end depending on least significant word first quirk, clamps final group size, then selects offset inside group from low or high end depending on little endian quirk, returning combined physical index.

Structure conversion moves exactly one two four or eight bytes at given offset between memory and sixty four bit value, selecting width by declared field size and defaulting wider or unusual sizes to eight byte transfer.

Bulk helpers iterate descriptor arrays, convert each structure field to or from intermediate value, and apply single field transfer with shared buffer length and quirks, with separate entry points for narrow and wide descriptor types but identical traversal semantics.

Test data defines cases with description expected bytes length value bit range and quirks, covering fixed value at fixed offset across quirk combinations and varying buffer lengths to exercise layout permutations.

Non sleepable one shot path holds a dedicated spinlock with interrupt state saved across done check, releases with restored state when already done or at finish, and uses annotations to balance analysis when early return skips finish.
Sleepable one shot path holds a dedicated mutex across done check, releases when already done or at finish, and uses annotations to balance analysis when early return skips finish.

Deferred deactivation carrier holds a work item plus pointer to jump key and owning module, initialized by allocator path and consumed by worker to disable optimization, release module reference, and free carrier.
Test case record holds description pointer, expected buffer pointer and size, numeric value, start and end bit positions, and quirk flags.

Pool control observed through use holds possible processor count, per object size, slot capacity, allocation flags, opaque context, cleanup callback, array of per processor slot pointers, reference count, and retained object count.

Pool moves from uninitialized to ready after successful creation with reference preset to retained objects plus one, remains ready while objects are extracted or dropped, transitions to freed when single drop reaches zero or bulk drain subtracts drained count plus self reference, invoking user cleanup exactly once during free.

Flag starts false with optimization enabled; first starter observes false under protection and proceeds, finish sets true releases protection and schedules worker; later starters observe true and skip payload; worker asserts optimization still enabled then disables it and cleans up.

Error injection moves from absent to armed when debug directory creation succeeds and notifier registration succeeds, returns to absent with directory removal on registration failure, and returns to absent by unregistering then removing directory during exit.

Module style entry initializes injection directory and registers for five reconfiguration actions with configurable priority, and exit unregisters and removes directory, exposing attach detach add remove and update property actions for fault injection.

Creation can leave partially built per processor slots on allocation or slot initialization failure, requiring virtual aware release of each pointer including nulls; mismatched allocator pairing or missing cleanup on failure would leak; teardown assumes pointer array validity after null check.

Store warns and truncates when value exceeds width for sub sixty four bit fields while always accepting full sixty four bit values; callers passing inverted ranges or oversized widths receive distinct errors; bulk helpers perform no range validation themselves.

Rendering can encounter insufficient caller space and signals exhaustion without completing output; malformed empty or truncated encodings produce bad marker plus error; parsing trusts length byte equality and does not further validate payload beyond lookup.

Deferred deactivation allocation uses atomic context and silently skips scheduling when allocation fails, leaving optimization enabled; worker enforces enabled expectation and would trap if disable were duplicated or raced.

Packing direction distinguishes store versus load operation, quirk selection combines least significant word first little endian and most significant bit on right behaviours, and zero quirk value denotes default big endian most significant bit left layout.

Reconfiguration fault injection covers attach detach add remove and update property actions; object identifier parsing expects object identifier tag with length byte equal to payload size and lookup sentinel denotes absence.

Negative error signalling distinguishes invalid arguments, out of memory, retryable non final release, bad message encoding, exhausted output space, and out of range width across pool identifier and packing interfaces.
